description: This file defines the CardsProvider class, which manages a collection of card objects, handles loading data through a repository, and provides status updates and notifications for a Flutter application.

classes.name: CardsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass that manages a list of BankCard objects and provides methods to load and update their status, notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Static method to initialize a CardsProvider instance asynchronously, loading initial data from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Asynchronous method to reload the list of cards from the repository, updating the loading state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Asynchronous method to update the status of a specific card and refresh the card list.
